messages:
Maya S.: FYI PR #371 (sdk-snippets/python) needs reviewers. Target merge in Fri morning deploy. Need two approvals and a quick CI/docs-preview sanity check.

Carlos V.: I can review the Python snippets for idiomatic usage. Not available during standup 09:15-09:45.

Rina D.: Im on doc rotation today. Can take a pass on wording and link sanity. Will check preview after standup.

Maya S.: Thanks. The author added a new example showing client batching; check snapshots for output differences. Also a failing link-check was noted in CI last run.

docs-bot: CI: Preview build queued for PR #371.

Carlos V.: Local preview shows: 
ERROR: link-check: /api/batch-client -> 404
WARN: snippet-output-mismatch: examples/python/batching.md line 28

Rina D.: Looks like the slug changed. @Maya S. can we allow reviewers to push small fixes (link redirect + snapshot update)? Author is traveling.

Maya S.: Yes reviewers may push non-controversial fixes. Please add an inline comment on anything substantive.

Priya R.: Heads-up: I can merge once we have two approvals + green CI and if merge window is respected. Please add label docs/needs-2-approvals and docs/merge-window:2026-03-27-09:00.

Carlos V.: Pushed a small commit to fix the link to /guides/batching-client and updated the output snapshot to match current runtime. Triggering preview.

docs-bot: CI: Build passed for PR #371. Preview URL: https://docs-preview.redwood.com/pr/371/build/4

Rina D.: Reviewed wording and anchors. Approving.

Carlos V.: Approved (snippet review).

Priya R.: Two approvals and green CI. Merging in the scheduled window. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
